profileCompleteness.statement: This source-grounded register covers the R7 ontology and known PRE-RICH/V3 components, but does not prove that they exhaust all economic content the profile can create.
closureBlockers: PA2: no authoritative exhaustive enumeration of all profile assets/commitments mapped exactly once.
PA3: no complete A4↔L3 pairing/disjointness proof.
PA4: no complete valuation function for each applicable cell, including Ω-worst-case L3.
PA5/PA6: no proof every operation preserves permitted deltas and L6 is empty.
PA7: no independent adversarial omission review.
EV1-EV7 and P1-P8: no authenticated deployment EEV and complete authoritative perimeter package.
NV1-NV5: no authenticated live S0 evidence.

PA2 adversarial-source expansion: original 17 rows omitted multiple normative application transitions and right-carrying objects, including sale coupling, frozen payout, claim/expiry, transfer identity, Jackpot funding/payout and settlement conversion.
PA7: the source-derived surface map includes 15 required normative/implementation anchors, but remains a curated checklist, not independent proof that all economic content is enumerated.

auditBoundary.classification: MECHANICAL EVIDENCE — SOURCE-DERIVED COVERAGE CHECKLIST; NOT PA2/PA7 CLOSURE
auditBoundary.statement: This checklist indexes normative transition and implementation surfaces omitted from the original 17-component register. It detects missing checklist rows and source drift; because the checklist itself is curated, a passing result does not prove exhaustive economic coverage.
auditBoundary.independentReview: No separate human/organizational adversarial reviewer attestation is represented by this artifact.
